items.note: Compares ideation with the FlexMind scaffold against plain ChatGPT (AI-configuration contrast, no no-AI arm); participants produced higher-quality ideas with FlexMind; N not stated in the arXiv abstract.

Lancet Digital Health Comment with no abstract (only the opening paragraph was reachable); search notes say ophthalmology research ideas from young researchers alone (n=3), LLMs alone, and LLM-assisted researchers were scored by 15 masked experts; very small sample, registered ChiCTR2500097263.

Comparative study (N=16) of StepIdeator, a step-by-step generative-AI design tool, against a baseline tool in product conceptual design; reports improved idea externalization and creativity, but the abstract does not say whether creativity was rated on outputs.

Two teams of four designers ideated for four hours with conventional methods or with ChatGPT-4/Bard; experts rated idea creativity (on par) and the AI team produced about 1.67 times as many ideas; team-level, non-random-looking design.

Within-subjects Wizard-of-Oz study comparing intrusive next-sentence and non-intrusive exploratory proactive AI suggestions in story outlining (AI-configuration contrast with a human wizard as the AI); reports enhanced creativity; search notes give N=30.

Two-phase comparison (30-person pilot, 72-person validation) of GUI digital cards, TUI physical cards, and a traditional LLM story-writing approach; outcomes include creative autonomy and emotional expression, which may be self-reported.

Wordcraft user study in which participants wrote short stories with and without an LLM-powered editor; abstract reports co-writing experiences, not rated creativity, so the outcome may be qualitative only.

Comparative user study where young designers ideated with a generative concept-text mode (model fine-tuned on Red Dot winners) versus a conventional search mode; findings in the abstract are qualitative, and it is unclear whether ideas were scored.

Comparative experiment with 12 middle-school students using the LLM mentor agent Mentigo for creative problem solving, with five expert educators evaluating creativity and task performance; CHI 2025 version of arXiv 2409.14228.

ICIS 2024 paper that proposes a 2x2 between-subjects experiment varying breadth and depth of exploration in a custom GenAI ideation tool (Idea Hub) with ideation performance and dignity outcomes; abstract says "proposes", so it may be research in progress with no data yet.
